context: constraint: scenarios as WHEN/THEN with one observable outcome
intent: Let a reader review a living spec: approve all with undo, see new requirements and cross-spec links, undo removals, open at a requirement from anywhere

decisions.decision: Hold one pending undo per panel in the extension and render the existing UndoToast from NavState.livingUndo
decisions.why: Every refresh regenerates the webview page, so webview-held undo state is wiped by the write it would undo (spec-viewer-living)

decisions.decision: Append requirement-removed entries to history[] in a .spec-context.json beside the spec file, naming the capability, written directly rather than via updateSpecContext
decisions.why: Colocated capabilities share a directory, and updateSpecContext stamps feature-spec defaults a capability lacks (spec-viewer-living)
decisions.rejected: A marker line in the spec file, or a key in living-specs.yml

decisions.decision: One in-process requirementLinks function over requirementSlices feeds cards and the Remove refusal; delete alignsIn
decisions.why: alignsIn matched markers anywhere including fences, so the refusal and the cards could disagree (specs-living-model)
decisions.rejected: Shelling out to the resolver from the editor

decisions.decision: New marks computed by git show main:<path> in the post-paint health push; any failure leaves them absent
decisions.why: git can be slow or absent and the slow-fact path already races a timeout and drops stale results (spec-viewer-living)
decisions.rejected: Computing on first paint, or parsing git diff

decisions.decision: New is a separate data-req-new attribute and pill, not a card state
decisions.why: data-req-state is single-valued, so a new drifted card would lose a fact (viewer-ui-document)

decisions.decision: Move Approve all from the header to the living footer bar
decisions.why: One action, one button, next to its Undo (viewer-ui-chrome)

decisions.decision: FR-011 lands as a removal-record skip in living_validate.py delta-heading-not-found; drift and doctor have no missing-requirement check to change
decisions.why: The validator is the only place a deliberately removed heading raises a false alarm (capture-runtime-living-resolve)
decisions.rejected: Building a new doctor check only to exempt removals

decisions.decision: Open Living Spec command titled without an ellipsis; tree row and chips keep opening at the top
decisions.why: The spec pins SpecKit: Open Living Spec, and those entry points name no requirement (specs-living-view)
decisions.rejected: Adding requirement child rows to the tree

decisions.decision: Pending undo lives in a Map on the spec viewer provider, offered and taken through two handler dependencies
decisions.why: Every write regenerates the webview page, so webview state would be wiped by the write it undoes

decisions.decision: Only Approve all offers Undo, not a single card Approve
decisions.why: The spec scopes Undo to Approve all and Remove; a single approve settles nothing and a pending Undo still refuses if the file changed

decisions.decision: Cards read their links from navState.livingOverview instead of a new renderer setter
decisions.why: The overview already rides in the initial nav state, so no extra wiring in the webview entry
decisions.rejected: setLivingLinks called from the entry point and applyNavState

decisions.decision: leansOn and leanedOnBy are optional on overview requirements
decisions.why: Many fixtures and stories build overview rows without links; the provider always sets them
decisions.rejected: Required fields and edits to every fixture

decisions.decision: git show main:./<path>, relative to the workspace
decisions.why: Works when the workspace root is not the repository root
decisions.rejected: main:<path>, which is relative to the repo root

plan.summary: Planned living-spec review by wiring existing approve, remove, open-at-requirement, slow-fact push and UndoToast together, plus a resolver flag and a removal record
plan.key_finding: The webview page is regenerated on every refresh, so Undo must live on the extension-side panel state
